info.title: API.SH: Songkick
info.description: The Songkick API from API.SH: public Songkick data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
An artist's upcoming concerts on Songkick (or past ones with `past=1`), each with date, venue with address and coordinates, lineup with genres and ticket availability, plus the artist's name, image, tour summary, upcoming count and touring countries. Pages with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/songkick-artist

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Songkick artist id, alone or with its name (253846 or 253846-radiohead).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: An artist name; the first search match is used.

parameters.name: past
parameters.description: 1 for past concerts (gigography) instead of upcoming.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Radiohead
example.summary: Radiohead is currently touring across 2 countries and has 21 upcoming concerts. Their next tour date is at RAC Arena in Perth, after that th…

get.description:
One Songkick concert or festival: date and time, status (scheduled, cancelled, past), doors time, venue with address, coordinates, capacity and page, lineup (headliner and support), ticket offers and seller links, RSVP count and description. Pass `id` or `url`, or `metro` or `artist` to get the next upcoming concert there or by them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/songkick-concert

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Songkick concert or festival page.

parameters.name: metro
parameters.description: Metro area id; returns its next concert.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Artist name or id; returns their next concert.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Korn @ The O2
example.description: Korn, Architects, and Youth Code at The O2 at 2026-11-04T18:00:00+0000

get.description:
A festival on Songkick with every edition: name, dates, status, venue with address and coordinates, the full line-up (artists with genres and Songkick links) and ticket offers. Pass `next_page` back as `page` for older editions.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/songkick-festival

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Festival id, or a songkick.com/festivals/<id>-<name> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

editions.name: Get Loaded in the Park 2011 @ Clapham Common
Get Loaded in the Park 2010 @ Clapham Common

get.description:
Upcoming concerts in a Songkick metro area, optionally between two dates, 50 per page, each with name, date, venue with address and coordinates, performers with genres and ticket availability. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/songkick-metro

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Songkick metro area id, alone or with its name (24426-uk-london, 7644-us-new-york-nyc, 17835-us-los-angeles-la).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Songkick for artists, venues or upcoming events, with paging. Each result has type, id, name, page, image and a short detail (such as the number of upcoming events).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/songkick-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Songkick venue with address, coordinates, website and capacity, and its upcoming concerts with paging.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/songkick-venue

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Songkick venue id, alone or with its name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A venue name; the first search match is used.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
